blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Cordillera Human Rights Alliance (CHRA) welcomed the acquittal of several activists in Ilocos Region and the Cordillera Administrative Region in what it described as fabricated cases meant to silence those who stand with the oppressed. Atty. Randy Kinaud, counsel for community doctor Ana Marie Rilloraza-Leung and Indigenous people’s (IP) rights advocate, said the case “had no merit and lacked sufficient evidence to substantiate the accusations from the very beginning.” Leung and Sungay, were among the six people arrested in Tarlac on March 11, where the police and military conducted a raid targetting alleged rebel leaders operating in […]...
